securityNotes: Single-file prose skill (SKILL.md only, ~40 lines, no scripts/binaries/references). Frontmatter uses only name+description. No network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or user-rule-bypassing instructions. Read in full at the pinned commit via a local codeload tarball extraction.

proposedEntry.name: design-ethics
proposedEntry.description: Reviews interface, growth, and monetization designs for consent, privacy, attention, and manipulation concerns. Directs checking transparency and informed consent, avoiding dark patterns (forced continuity, hidden costs, trick questions), attention/addictive-design risk, inclusive and non-discriminatory treatment, privacy-by-design in interface choices, and honest defaults with easy opt-out. Verification checklist confirms consent/cancellation paths are clear and fair, no intentional deception in critical choices, and the team can explain how the design respects user interests.
triggers: audit this growth tactic for manipulation
inputs: flow, screen, or growth/monetization tactic to review
